# Anxious Minds

> A North East-based mental health charity providing counselling, community support, and specialized services for veterans, workplaces, and recovery programs.

Anxious Minds is an award-winning mental health organization serving Newcastle, North Tyneside, and the broader North East region since 2015. They offer comprehensive services including individual counselling, corporate wellness programs, veteran support, outdoor therapy, and community recovery initiatives through partnerships with organizations like the Veteran Recovery College and Sporting Minds.

## Key Topics

- Mental health counselling
- Veterans support
- Community mental health
- Workplace mental health
- Recovery programs
- Outdoor therapy
- Corporate services
- North East UK
- Mental health charity
- Veteran Recovery College
- Hope Drop in Recovery Centre
- Employee wellbeing
- Mental health training
- Community support services
- PTSD and addiction support

## Veterans and Specialized Support

- [Veterans Mental Health Services](https://www.anxiousminds.co.uk/veterans-mental-health-services): Veteran mental health counselling and addiction support services
- [Veterans Mental Health Support](https://www.anxiousminds.co.uk/veterans-mental-health-north-east): Veterans mental health support addressing PTSD, depression and anxiety
- [Veterans and Families Support](https://www.anxiousminds.co.uk/veteransfamilies): Veterans and families support via Veteran Recovery College programs
- [Veteran and Community Kitchen](https://www.anxiousminds.co.uk/veteran-community-kitchen): Veteran and Community Kitchen supporting veterans and community wellbeing
- [Outdoor Therapy](https://www.anxiousminds.co.uk/outdoor-therapy): Sporting Minds outdoor therapy project for mental health recovery
